Place Compare (aka Liveability)
===============================

**This cross-platform app was generated by** `Briefcase`_ **- part of**
`The BeeWare Project`_. **If you want to see more tools like Briefcase, please
consider** `becoming a financial member of BeeWare`_.

*Compare locations by their nearby services*

Add services and addresses for locations you care about and the tool will use Apple Maps
to calculate ETAs between each allowing you to compare their liveability.

(Apple App Store made me change the name from its original "Liveability" to "Place Compare"
which is somewhat uninspired and therefore I haven't changed the internal name.)
